positions.name: CalibrationStatusRatification
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration status established and ratified?
positions.why: All three expressions perform the establishment and ratification of the spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz — from initial status announcement (src-1), through verification against June reference plates across the full observing band (src-2), to formal ratification as a key decision (src-3). The set holds a conviction gradient from claim to decision, reflecting the progression from asserted fact to settled operational record; the relational moves shift from authority-ranking (announcing) through equality-matching (verifying against a standard) back to authority-ranking (ratifying as decision).
